requirement: A turn whose only writes were media uploads gives the site's write lease back when it ends

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: leaseHolders was recorded by makesReadsStale, which leaves out media.upload/media.delete, while the door takes the lease for them; the lease then held ~90 s after the turn
oracle.invariant: S1: a lease release is sent for the session at turn end. S2: no lease release is sent (the preview took none). S3: no release is sent, the first try included.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: 🔒 C3: a turn whose only write was a media upload gives the write lease back when it ends
🔒 C3: a media delete preview takes no lease, so the turn that only previewed releases none
🔒 C6: a lease release asks whether the lease is still this turn's before its FIRST send too
